proposed.explanation: The controlling source is PD 1096 Rule II Sections 214 to 216 and the abatement/demolition procedure that follows. Section 214 defines dangerous buildings, Section 215 gives the Building Official repair/vacation/demolition response and defect categories, Section 216 preserves other remedies, and the procedure provides notice and appeal steps.
